d: Temba Bavuma has once again answered his critics, leading South Africa’s fightback with a gritty 179 against Australia. From being questioned as a player to becoming the captain who led South Africa to the World Test Championship title, Bavuma’s journey is one of resilience, leadership and proving his doubters wrong. What makes Temba Bavuma such an important figure in South African cricket? Rupha Ramani looks at the captain’s remarkable rise, his defining performances and the fight that continues to shape his career.
